sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with 2(a) C.C. No.61 of 2023 pending on the file of learned 1st Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Cuttack, arising out of P.R. Case No.683 of 2022-23 of E.I. & E.B. Unit-II, Cuttack for commission of offence alleged under Sections 20(b)(ii)C of the NDPS Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge, Cuttack by order dated 18.03.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is stated that the Petitioner is in custody since 22.03.2023.
5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner is not in a position to apprise this Court regarding the stage of trial nor the same is reflected in the impugned order.
6. Taking note of the same, Registry is requested to call for a report from the learned Court in seisin regarding the stage of trial.
7. In the meanwhile, learned counsel for the Petitioner is called upon to file a copy of the final form Suraj Kumar vs State Of Odisha ....
